name: Shopify
description: Show your Shopify store's sales, orders, latest order and low-stock alerts, with a new-order alert page.
author: FiestaBoard Team

shop_domain.title: Store Domain
shop_domain.description: Your store's .myshopify.com address, e.g. your-store.myshopify.com (find it in Shopify admin under Settings > Domains).

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: From your app in the Shopify Dev Dashboard (Settings). Use this with the Client secret, or leave both empty and use an Admin API access token instead.

client_secret.title: Client Secret
client_secret.description: From your app in the Shopify Dev Dashboard (Settings). FiestaBoard uses it to get a new access token every 24 hours.

access_token.title: Admin API Access Token (legacy apps)
access_token.description: Only for custom apps created in the Shopify admin before 2026 (starts with shpat_). Leave empty when using a Client ID and secret.

sales_period.title: Sales Period
sales_period.description: Which period the sales and order totals cover, in your store's timezone. Weeks start on Monday.

include_test_orders.title: Include Test Orders
include_test_orders.description: Count test orders (placed with Shopify's test payment gateway). Turn on for development stores, where every order is a test order.

low_stock_threshold.title: Low Stock Threshold
low_stock_threshold.description: Flag active products with this many units or fewer. 0 turns low-stock tracking off. Needs the read_products scope.

enable_triggers.title: New Order Alerts
enable_triggers.description: Interrupt the board with a new-order page when an order comes in.

alert_duration_seconds.title: Alert Duration (seconds)
alert_duration_seconds.description: How long the new-order page stays on the board.

trigger_page_id.title: Alert Page
trigger_page_id.description: Page to show when a new order comes in. Leave blank for the built-in NEW ORDER display. The page can use any {{shopify.*}} variable; last_order_* describe the new order.

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh Interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often to check Shopify. New-order alerts appear within one refresh.

env_vars.name: SHOPIFY_SHOP_DOMAIN
env_vars.description: Store domain, e.g. your-store.myshopify.com (alternative to the UI setting)

env_vars.name: SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID
env_vars.description: Dev Dashboard app Client ID (alternative to the UI setting)

env_vars.name: SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET
env_vars.description: Dev Dashboard app Client secret (alternative to the UI setting)

env_vars.name: SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN
env_vars.description: Legacy custom app Admin API access token (alternative to the UI setting)

sales_line.description: Period and sales together, ready to display

sales_display.description: Sales for the period in whole currency units

sales.description: Sales for the period as a plain number with cents

period_label.description: The period the totals cover: TODAY, THIS WEEK or THIS MONTH

orders_line.description: Order count with the word ORDER or ORDERS

order_count.description: Number of orders in the period

avg_order_display.description: Average order value for the period

last_order_line.description: Latest order number, total and age together

last_order_ago.description: How long ago the latest order was placed

low_stock_line.description: Low-stock summary (empty when tracking is off)

low_stock_count.description: Number of variants at or below the threshold

low_stock_item.description: The variant with the least stock

screenshots.alt: Shopify store sales, orders and latest order on a FiestaBoard
screenshots.caption: Today's sales, order count, latest order and low-stock count
